items.statement: Fewer than half of adults in the network have a recall interval concordant with their recorded risk category.
items.rationale: Other record studies found most adults on six-month recall regardless of risk (claim c1).
items.risks: Concordance depends on an unreliable risk field.

items.statement: Adults in the most deprived quintile more often have no recall interval recorded.
Practices with structured templates set more risk-concordant intervals.
items.risks: Only 14 practices, so practice-level comparisons are weak.
